findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_services, ecb_fx_rates, tender_alerts, domain_check, email_verify · Private data: lookup_company, domain_check · Public sink: domain_check, email_verify.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_services, ecb_fx_rates, tender_alerts, domain_check, email_verify · Private data: lookup_company, domain_check · Public sink: domain_check, email_verify

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
